command:
import json
import gymnasium as gym
from oceanscale.training.isaaclab_env import OceanScaleDirectRLEnv
result = {
    'isaaclab_direct_rl_env_importable': False,
    'isaaclab_direct_rl_abstract_methods': [],
    'isaaclab_direct_rl_hooks': [
        '_pre_physics_step', '_apply_action', '_get_observations',
        '_get_rewards', '_get_dones', '_reset_idx'
    ],
    'gym_adapter': {
        'class': 'OceanScaleDirectRLEnv',
        'is_gym_env': issubclass(OceanScaleDirectRLEnv, gym.Env),
        'is_isaaclab_direct_rl_env': False,
        'mode': 'gym_vector_adapter',
    },
    'native_task': {
        'class': 'OceanScaleTask',
        'importable': False,
        'is_isaaclab_direct_rl_env': False,
        'hooks_present': [],
        'hooks_missing': [],
        'cfg_is_direct_rl_env_cfg': False,
        'cfg_has_validate': False,
        'cfg_has_sim': False,
        'cfg_has_scene': False,
        'instantiation_tested': False,
        'mode': 'native_scaffold_unverified',
    },
}
try:
    from isaaclab.envs import DirectRLEnv, DirectRLEnvCfg
except Exception as exc:
    result['isaaclab_direct_rl_env_error'] = repr(exc)
else:
    abstract_methods = sorted(getattr(DirectRLEnv, '__abstractmethods__', ()))
    result['isaaclab_direct_rl_env_importable'] = True
    result['isaaclab_direct_rl_abstract_methods'] = abstract_methods
    result['gym_adapter']['is_isaaclab_direct_rl_env'] = issubclass(OceanScaleDirectRLEnv, DirectRLEnv)
    try:
        from oceanscale.training.isaaclab_task import OceanScaleTask, OceanScaleTaskCfg
    except Exception as exc:
        result['native_task']['error'] = repr(exc)
    else:
        cfg = OceanScaleTaskCfg(num_envs=1)
        hooks_present = [
            name for name in result['isaaclab_direct_rl_hooks'] if name in OceanScaleTask.__dict__
        ]
        hooks_missing = [
            name for name in result['isaaclab_direct_rl_hooks'] if name not in OceanScaleTask.__dict__
        ]
        cfg_is_direct = isinstance(cfg, DirectRLEnvCfg)
        cfg_has_validate = hasattr(cfg, 'validate')
        cfg_has_sim = getattr(cfg, 'sim', None) is not None
        cfg_has_scene = getattr(cfg, 'scene', None) is not None
        result['native_task'].update({
            'importable': True,
            'is_isaaclab_direct_rl_env': issubclass(OceanScaleTask, DirectRLEnv),
            'hooks_present': hooks_present,
            'hooks_missing': hooks_missing,
            'cfg_is_direct_rl_env_cfg': cfg_is_direct,
            'cfg_has_validate': cfg_has_validate,
            'cfg_has_sim': cfg_has_sim,
            'cfg_has_scene': cfg_has_scene,
        })
        if result['native_task']['is_isaaclab_direct_rl_env'] and not hooks_missing:
            if cfg_is_direct and cfg_has_validate and cfg_has_sim and cfg_has_scene:
                result['native_task']['mode'] = 'isaaclab_native_direct_rl_cfg_ready'
            else:
                result['native_task']['mode'] = 'isaaclab_native_direct_rl_env_scaffold'
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
